q: Hearts of Iron IV France focus tree guide Defensive Focus Firepower Kills Army Reform Victors of the Great War
answer:
The search results partly answer this, but note that the Paradox Wiki pages returned a “Client Challenge” error, so only the mobile-section snippet and a 2023 guide are usable.

For France’s defensive branch in Hearts of Iron IV, the focus tree snippet says: take **Begin Rearmament** (requires >12% War Support; gives 2 random core states 2 building slots and 2 military factories each), then **Defensive Focus** (mutually exclusive with Aggressive Focus; +30 command power; unlocks Maxime Weygand as Chief of Army with +10% Division Defense). Next, **Firepower Kills** (mutually exclusive with Methodical Battle) gives the national spirit **Firepower**, reducing Towed Artillery production cost by 10%. Then **Levée en masse** gives +5 army experience and reduces Infantry Equipment production cost by 10%. The branch ends with the shared **Army Reform**, which removes the starting national spirit **Victors of the Great War** ([hoi4.paradoxwikis.com](https://hoi4.paradoxwikis.com/index.php?mobileaction=toggle_view_desktop&section=2&title=French_national_focus_tree)).

A 2023 guide also recommends Begin Rearmament, then industry focuses, Economic Devolution, and working down Defensive Focus toward Army Reform ([keengamer.com](https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/hoi4-guide-france-made-easy-2023/)). These may reflect an older version.

q: Hearts of Iron IV fuel production from oil conversion rate per day
answer:
In Hearts of Iron IV, each unit of oil produces **48 units of fuel per day** by default, according to the [hoi4.paradoxwikis.com](https://hoi4.paradoxwikis.com/index.php?mobileaction=toggle_view_mobile&title=Fuel&veaction=edit) wiki and the [hoi4-fr.paradoxwikis.com](https://hoi4-fr.paradoxwikis.com/Carburant) French wiki. This equals a base gain of 2 fuel per hour (`BASE_FUEL_GAIN_PER_OIL = 2` × 24 hours).

Fuel refining technologies can significantly increase this efficiency, and economy laws below War Economy reduce it. The modifier "Fuel gain per oil" (available from v1.6 onward) changes this rate proportionally—common vanilla values are 0.1, 0.15, and 0.2, per [hagane.works](https://scharnhorst.hagane.works/en/wiki/modifier/fuel_gain_factor).

Synthetic refineries also provide 48 fuel daily as a baseline, potentially up to 168 per day with technologies, and are not penalized by economy laws.

Note: The [forum.paradoxplaza.com](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/hoi4-dev-diary-fuel-review-and-motorized-artillery.1144796/page-12) dev diary and [simulationian.com](https://simulationian.com/2019/01/hoi4-dd20190109/) (January 2019) describe the fuel system rework, confirming oil is converted to fuel hourly rather than used directly in production.

q: Hearts of Iron IV France focus tree "Disjointed Government" how to remove Political Unity Utilize the Leagues National Regeneration
answer:
The search results answer this, but they reflect older/unspecified versions of Hearts of Iron IV rather than a dated current patch.

According to the HOI4 Wiki’s French national focus tree page, **Political Unity** removes the **Disjointed Government** national spirit. Its prerequisite is **National Regeneration**, which in turn requires **Utilize the Leagues** ([hoi4.paradoxwikis.com](https://hoi4.paradoxwikis.com/French_national_focus_tree)).

The path shown is: **Utilize the Leagues → National Regeneration → Political Unity**. **National Regeneration** requires **Utilize the Leagues** and is mutually exclusive with **The Council of Rambouillet**, and it needs combined Unaligned + Fascist support over 50%. **Utilize the Leagues** requires **Revive the National Bloc**, not having completed **Review Foreign Policy**, and full independence ([hoi4.paradoxwikis.com](https://hoi4.paradoxwikis.com/index.php?mobileaction=toggle_view_desktop&section=2&title=French_national_focus_tree)).

A 2026 guide also notes National Regeneration needs 50% combined fascist/non-aligned support and is mutually exclusive with the Napoleonic route ([guides-factory.com](https://guides-factory.com/guides/hoi4-france-guide)). The results do not give a patch date, so verify in your current game version.

q: HoI4 Japan how to start the war with China before focus "Revisit the Twenty-One Demands" requires at war with China, Marco Polo Bridge incident event or decision
answer:
I couldn't confirm the "Revisit the Twenty-One Demands" focus or its exact requirements. None of the results mentioned it, so it may come from a mod or a newer patch than the sources cover.

For the war start, the sources say Japan usually needs the **Marco Polo Bridge Incident** national focus to begin the Second Sino-Japanese War. Japan's reluctance to justify war goals under Hirohito makes this the normal route. Other options:

- **World tension at 75%**, which lets Japan enter the war without the focus.
- **A Chinese "Pick a Fight With Japan" or "Provoke Japan" focus**, which starts the war for Japan.

Taking the Marco Polo focus applies a penalty to Japan's army against China (listed as -50% attack and -25% defense). The "escalate the war in China" decision or the "Secure China" focus can remove it.

The sources disagree on when to take the focus. One guide puts it after Spiritual Mobilization and before the Greater East Asian Co-Prosperity Sphere. The guides also come from different game versions, one of them 1.17, so check the current in-game tree or the wiki's version notes before relying on this.
